Metadata.title: LovMy — Never be lonely
Metadata.description: LovMy is the next-generation dating platform that connects the intelligence of matching with the warmth of human connection.

Hero.subtitle: When intelligence meets attraction.
Hero.description: The dating app where algorithmic precision and emotional warmth become one. Find someone who's really like you.

Concept.title: One heart, two worlds
Concept.techText: Clean lines, precision, augmented matchmaking. The "machine" part of the logo embodies safe, reliable matching. Signature colour: Midnight Steel.
Concept.humanText: Soft curves, gaze, presence. The "living" part of the logo carries desire, tenderness, real encounters. Signature colours: Passion Red & Tender Pink.
Concept.value1Text: Data in service of the bond, never the other way around. Discreet, fair, relevant.
Concept.value2Text: We speak to the heart. Warmth, sincerity, controlled intensity.
Concept.value3Text: Lacquered red, deep black, space. An experience that feels high-end.

Features.title: Built for real encounters
Features.matchingText: A compatibility algorithm that learns from your preferences to suggest profiles that truly matter to you.
Features.securityText: 4-step verification (email, phone, selfie, ID document) and active moderation of profiles and content.
Features.videoText: Built-in HD audio and video calls, right from your conversations, before meeting in person.
Features.premiumText: Unlimited likes, incognito mode, profile boost, rewind, and advanced filters to go further.

Testimonials.title: Never be lonely, for real
Testimonials.quote1: We matched on a Tuesday evening. Three months later, we were moving in together.
Testimonials.quote2: Video calls before meeting in person change everything. No more bad surprises.
Testimonials.quote3: The matching is stunningly relevant. I finally stopped swiping into the void.

DownloadCta.title: Take LovMy with you
DownloadCta.text: The mobile app is coming soon to iOS and Android. In the meantime, sign up on the web.
